verdict.rationale: Grafana's Explore view supports ad-hoc queries, drilldown, and side-by-side comparison of queries and time ranges (grafana-gh-1). Loki has a documented query language, LogQL, with label filtering and operators (grafana-docs-15), and metrics are queried through Mimir and PromQL (grafana-docs-34, grafana-docs-59). missing for 10: in-depth query-language reference documentation beyond a one-line LogQL mention, a documented trace query language, and independent hands-on corroboration of ad-hoc query workflows (one community user could not find where to explore logs, and another cited thin docs for pulling data).
